This is a multiplayer stadium. Play with your friends either 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, or 4v4.

EVERYBODY needs Bakkesmod Net Code Plugin (#166) in order to BOOM.

Press the "Use Item" button to BOOM. BOOM next to the ball. BOOM next to other players.

Recommended game settings:

Respawn Time - 1 second

Also try boomer mode settings for more fun.

My personal favorite was heavy ball.

This map is the first of possibly many inside a brand new Rocket League Circus tent I created. This map features 2 ramps with a ring of fire in the center of the field, hanging from the ceiling. Welcome to UP THE WALL by MissMachoTV
Similar to side swipe, this goal is in the upper center of the wall! To add a little extra weirdness, the map is also turned 90 degrees so it is wider instead of longer. All boost pads are also turned with the rest of the field. Lets see how that throws off normal rotations!

maps.author: Lethamyr
maps.summary: Description
maps.description:
Description
Volleyshot is a combination of Dropshot and Volleyball, where the goal is the same: score in the floor of the opponent’s side. However, in this version of Volleyshot, the wall is removed so you’re free to travel to either side of the field. Think of this map as Dropshot with a wall in the middle. Don’t get caught over-committing!
maps.recommendedSettings:
Time: Unlimited
Score Limit: You choose
Boost: Unlimited
